items.title: Extension by zero is left adjoint to restriction on the derived category
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that on the derived categories, extension by zero is left adjoint to restriction along the localization morphism attached to an object of a ringed site (statement lines 4546-4554). The proof recalls the abelian adjunction (proof lines 4556-4565) and then passes to the derived categories, using exactness of restriction so that no derived functor has to be computed beyond the given functors (proof lines 4565-4575). The non-formal content is the passage from the abelian adjunction to the derived one. The claim is H2: one adjunction upgraded through exactness.
